title: Active-slice formula for a free operadic algebra
statement:
Use the universe and monoidal conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid] and the generalized nonsymmetric infinity operads of [lem-coef-operadic-algebra-presentability]. Let $\mathcal M\to\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ be a small generalized nonsymmetric infinity operad with $\mathcal M_{[0]}$ a space, and let $\mathcal V$ be presentably monoidal. Let $\mathcal M_{\mathrm{triv}}$ be the subcategory containing all objects and only arrows lying over inert arrows, with inclusion $\tau:\mathcal M_{\mathrm{triv}}\to\mathcal M$. Then $\mathcal M_{\mathrm{triv}}\to\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ is again a small generalized nonsymmetric infinity operad with the same zero-fiber, and $\tau$ preserves inert arrows and is the identity over $[0]$. Its algebras identify naturally with $\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal M_{[1]},\mathcal V)$. Let $\tau_!\dashv\tau^*$ be the free extension adjunction of [lem-coef-operadic-free-extension]. Given $P:\mathcal M_{[1]}\to\mathcal V$, a color $c$, and $n\geq0$, let $\mathcal P^{\mathcal M}_{c,n}$ be the full subcategory of $\mathcal M_{\mathrm{triv}}\times_{\mathcal M}\mathcal M_{/c}$ on arrows $\alpha:y\to c$ over the active arrow $[n]\to[1]$. Here an arrow in $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ is active when its opposite preserves the two endpoints. If $y_i$ are the successive colors of $y$ selected by inert arrows, put $P^{\otimes}(y)=P(y_1)\otimes\cdots\otimes P(y_n)$, using the tensor unit for $n=0$. Then naturally
$$ (\tau^*\tau_!P)(c)\simeq\coprod_{n\geq0}\operatorname*{colim}_{(y\xrightarrow{\alpha}c)\in\mathcal P^{\mathcal M}_{c,n}}P^{\otimes}(y). $$
Under this equivalence the unit is the cocone map for $\operatorname{id}_c$ in arity one. For any $\mathcal M$-algebra $A$ and map $u:P\to\tau^*A$, the adjunct $\tau_!P\to A$ is the map of these colimit cocones whose component at $\alpha$ is $P^{\otimes}(y)\xrightarrow{\otimes_i u(y_i)}\bigotimes_i A(y_i)\xrightarrow{A(\alpha)}A(c)$. In arity zero this is the nullary operation of $A$. Substitution of active operations induces the operations of the free algebra under the displayed equivalence. All these identifications are natural on the functor infinity-category of $P$, and are compatible with operadic substitution, including the higher coherences.
